problems.message: read or declaration on members (principal, id) at schema.q:504:17: a meter-bounded prefix needs a read rule uniformly decided by its pinned columns; viewer query caller chain: digestPreview (at schema.q:521:1) -> digestCounts (at schema.q:522:22). `members[principal = reader]` does not decide its conversation-based read rule; a helper grants no system authority
problems.rewrite: use `first N` only for a separately named paged preview: `members where .principal = reader first 50 by .id after c` (declare `c: cursor ?` and follow its cursor); `first 50` is a partial preview, not an equivalent complete total. For a complete per-group read, scan by an index leading with conversation, id and pin the deciding columns (N_NEVER_COMPLETE). Or keep the complete scheduled job: this loop is permitted under the system job caller(s) digest's chunk meter. Inner recipient work must fit one chunk even when the outer sweep adapts its chunk size; an oversized recipient parks with E_BOUND rather than committing a partial total. See guide jobs
